decks.notes: This deck focuses on assembling a toolbox of creatures to combo off and overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution to fetch specific creatures like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Grist, the Hunger Tide, the deck aims to create powerful synergies that can quickly take over the game. The deck also includes utility creatures like Hapatra, Vizier of Poisons and Endurance to disrupt the opponent's strategy. With the mana acceleration provided by cards like Birds of Paradise and Ignoble Hierarch, the deck can quickly assemble its combo pieces and close out the game.

The key concept of this UR Aggro deck is to quickly and efficiently deal damage to the opponent using cheap and versatile spells like Lightning Bolt, Lava Dart, and Prismatic Ending, while also leveraging the prowess abilities of creatures like Sprite Dragon, Soul-Scar Mage, and Monastery Swiftspear. The deck aims to maintain a fast and aggressive pace, utilizing cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration to ensure consistent draws and efficient card advantage. Underworld Breach provides additional value by enabling the deck to cast spells from the graveyard, while Jegantha, the Wellspring provides a powerful companion option to support the deck's game plan.

The deck focuses on controlling the board by utilizing powerful elemental creatures and spells to disrupt the opponent's strategy. With a mix of removal spells, card draw, and powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six, the deck aims to slow down the opponent's game plan while ramping up its own resources. The Elemental subtype synergizes with cards like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Risen Reef to generate additional value and advantage. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outcontrol the opponent to secure a victory.

The main concept of this deck is to use Cascade mechanics to play powerful spells for free, while applying pressure with aggro creatures. By leveraging cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly. It also includes versatile cards like Brazen Borrower and Bonecrusher Giant for additional tempo plays. The deck is built to be fast and efficient, utilizing a mix of spells and creatures to keep the opponent on their toes. The inclusion of cards like Force of Negation helps protect the game plan and maintain momentum.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on quickly disrupting the opponent with counterspells and removal while also deploying aggressive threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler. The deck aims to efficiently control the board and apply pressure to the opponent, utilizing cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration to generate card advantage. The mana base is designed to facilitate early plays and ensure consistent access to both red and blue sources of mana. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a mix of disruption and aggression in a Modern 1 vs 1 format.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying efficient threats and disruption to control the game. It aims to apply pressure early with strong creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Spell Pierce and Counterspell. Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration provide card advantage and help smooth out draws. Unholy Heat and Lightning Bolt are versatile removal spells that can deal with threats efficiently. Murktide Regent provides a powerful late-game threat, while Ledger Shredder helps to filter the library and disrupt graveyard strategies. The mana base ensures consistent access to all necessary colors of mana.

This deck focuses on quickly equipping Colossus Hammer onto creatures, enabling them to deal huge amounts of damage in a single turn. The use of Puresteel Paladin and Sigarda's Aid allows for easy equipping without paying extra costs, while Stoneforge Mystic and Steelshaper's Gift help tutor for the necessary equipment pieces. In addition, the deck includes protection and disruption elements like Spell Pierce, Giver of Runes, and Esper Sentinel to ensure the combo can go off smoothly and efficiently. With the right setup, this deck can win games in a flash.

The main focus of this deck is to aggressively play spells with the Cascade mechanic, in order to overwhelm the opponent with powerful, free spells. By utilizing cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst to cascade into spells like Crashing Footfalls and Dead / Gone, the deck can quickly establish a board presence and apply pressure. The inclusion of cards like Leyline Binding and Force of Negation also allows for disruption of the opponent's strategies, while cards like Fury and Fire / Ice provide additional control and removal options. Overall, the deck aims to win quickly and decisively through a combination of aggression and disruption.

Utilize cascade mechanics to cheat out powerful cards like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Omniscience quickly, allowing for explosive turns and overwhelming board presence. The deck focuses on cascading into Glimpse of Tomorrow to shuffle your board into a new one and potentially bring out multiple big threats at once. With the ability to cast spells for free and manipulate the top of your deck with cards like Wavesifter and Shardless Agent, the deck aims to overwhelm your opponent and win in a single turn.

This deck utilizes a combination of equipment cards like Colossus Hammer and Sword of Fire and Ice, along with creatures like Puresteel Paladin and Stoneforge Mystic, to quickly assemble a powerful attacking force. The key strategy involves using Sigarda's Aid and Steelshaper's Gift to cheat equipment onto the battlefield, enabling explosive early game plays with cheap creatures like Ornithopter and Memnite carrying lethal equipment. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive assault, bypassing traditional defenses for a swift victory.

The main concept of this deck is to use a combination of mill cards and control elements to quickly deplete the opponent's library. By using cards like Hedron Crab, Ruin Crab, and Fractured Sanity to mill cards from their library, and control spells like Fatal Push and Drown in the Loch to keep the opponent's threats in check, this deck aims to win by decking the opponent out. With cards like Archive Trap and Tasha's Hideous Laughter providing additional mill power, this deck is a potent mill/combo archetype in the Modern format.

This deck aims to ramp up mana quickly with the UrzaTron lands and use powerful Planeswalkers like Karn Liberated and Ugin, the Spirit Dragon to control the game. It also includes powerful creatures like Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger and Thragtusk for added threats. The deck also includes ways to search for specific lands or artifacts to ensure consistency and can use cards like Noxious Revival and Pulse of Murasa for recursion. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to dominate the game through strong control elements and powerful threats.

This deck focuses on utilizing creatures with valuable abilities to tutor for specific creatures and combo pieces, creating a toolbox of versatile options to dominate the game. By efficiently ramping up mana with creatures like Wall of Roots and Birds of Paradise, the deck can quickly assemble powerful combinations and utilize cards like Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution to search for key pieces. Yawgmoth, Thran Physician acts as a potent engine for sacrificing creatures and drawing cards, while Grist, the Hunger Tide provides additional value and versatility in creature token generation.

The main concept of this deck is to mill the opponent's library as quickly as possible using cards that force them to put cards into their graveyard. The deck focuses on using cards like Hedron Crab, Ruin Crab, and Fractured Sanity to mill the opponent, while also utilizing cards like Archive Trap and Tasha's Hideous Laughter to mill large amounts of cards all at once. The goal is to deplete the opponent's library faster than they can draw cards, leading to a win through deck out. The deck also includes control elements like Spell Pierce and Fatal Push to disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The main concept of this deck revolves around using the Dredge mechanic to fill your graveyard with key creatures and spells, enabling you to quickly bring them back to the battlefield. By combining cards like Creeping Chill, Cathartic Reunion, and Darkblast with creatures like Narcomoeba, Ox of Agonas, Prized Amalgam, and Silversmote Ghoul, you can create explosive turns where you overwhelm your opponent with a constant stream of threats. The mana base of the deck is designed to support your game plan by providing the necessary colors and fixing for your spells.

The key concept of this deck is to efficiently control the board with counterspells and removal while quickly applying pressure with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining a consistent stream of threats to close out the game as fast as possible. The efficient use of cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration helps to maintain card advantage and dig deeper into the deck for key combo pieces. The land base is optimized for consistent mana production to support the dual strategy of control and aggression.
